messages.subject: help doesn't work
messages.body_plain:
Hello StatET Users,

I’ve gotten StatET to work with Eclipse and I’m loving it. The only thing that doesn’t seem to work is help - for example, both help(paste) and ?paste bring up the R help window, but it claims:

Help on topic paste
No help found on topic paste in any package in the R library.

This obviously does work in the base R console.

I’m using Eclipse 4.4.0, R 3.1.1 and MacOS X 10.9.4. I’ve Googled until my fingers bled and I realise it’s probably some sort of path issue but I just can’t seem to fix it.

Kind regards,
Elske van der Vaart

messages.subject: Data Viewer in debug mode
messages.body_plain:
Hi guys,

I just installed StatET in eclipse and found that it is so much better than
Rstudio especially in code browsing. However one important feature that I
cannot figure out how to make it work is that I cannot open a data frame
inside a function in Data Viewer when I am debugging. I don't have problem
viewing a data frame in .GlobalEnv, either by right clicking the variable
in Object Browser, or by typing openInEditor() command in the console. But
in the debug mode, Object Browser is not showing the current frame where I
am at, and using openInEditor() yields 'object not found' error and a blank
screen for that variable. Is there any way to make it work? Thank you!

Best,
H

messages.subject: active bindings and reference classes
messages.body_plain:
Dear list,
I notice that activeBindings automatically execute in StatET, regardless of whether the value of 'sym' in makeActiveBinding(sym, fun, env) was requested.
This  can be a problem when working with, eg, the new R6class. A simple way to demonstrate is as follows:
> makeActiveBinding("x", function() cat("activated"), .GlobalEnv)shows 'activated' on every new line of the R terminal regardless of whether "x" is called
I noticed that if auto-refresh on the object browser is manually disabled, this behavior stops, although I do not know a way of setting this as default.
Despite disabling the auto-refresh I often find that I will encounter an 'R disconnected', when working with active bindings, reference classes, and R6classes (packages like Shiny, Rook, R6 etc) in StatET.
Does anyone have similar stability issues of know why this may be the case?
Thanks.

[2014-10-18 00:18] Huigang Chen wrote:
> Hi guys,
>
> I just installed StatET in eclipse and found that it is so much better
> than Rstudio especially in code browsing. However one important feature
> that I cannot figure out how to make it work is that I cannot open a
> data frame inside a function in Data Viewer when I am debugging. I don't
> have problem viewing a data frame in .GlobalEnv, either by right
> clicking the variable in Object Browser, or by typing openInEditor()
> command in the console. But in the debug mode, Object Browser is not
> showing the current frame where I am at, and using openInEditor() yields
> 'object not found' error and a blank screen for that variable. Is there
> any way to make it work? Thank you!

A menu item to open the data viewer for items from the variables view is 
on the wishlist.

At moment you can only use a workaround and assign temporarily the 
variable or its environment to the global environment. For example for 
the variables in the current function:

assign("tmp", sys.frame(sys.nframe()), .GlobalEnv)

Then you can open the data frame as usual e.g. using the object browser, 
but you have to call the command each time you enter your function.

Regards,
Stephan
